scope: PostgreSQL custom enum-array labels with boundary whitespace through CSV and typed rebinding
contract: Custom enum-array labels with leading, trailing and two-sided spaces retain their exact array text representation.
The application schema-aware CSV insert plan preserves the enum array through typed insertion and does not modify a sibling row.
Typed enum-array rebinding preserves PostgreSQL array_to_json and array_send results; leading/trailing spaces, empty label, literal NULL and SQL NULL remain distinct.

custom_enum_array_suite.command: rtk cargo test --locked -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration value_contract_custom_enum_array -- --ignored

remaining: Other enum configurations and PostgreSQL array families remain open; this case does not close B3 or qualify 0.2.0.
